tha-ap533:1.1: Tiṇadāyakavaggo tepaññāso. LIV [528. Mahākaccāna.] Padumuttaro nāma jino anejo ajitañjayo / satasahasse kappānaṃ ito uppajji nāyako. // //
tha-ap533:4.1: Sambuddho bodhayaṃ satte vāgīso madhurassaro / karuṇāniḍḍhasantāno parisāsu visārado. // //
tha-ap533:5.1: Deseti madhuraṃ dhammaṃ catusaccupasaṅhitaṃ / nimugge mohapaṅkamhi samuddharati pāṇino. // //
tha-ap533:6.1: Tadā ekacaro hutvā tāpaso Himavālayo / nabhasā mānusaṃ lokaṃ gacchanto jinam addasaṃ. // //
tha-ap533:7.1: Upecca santikaṃ tassa assosiṃ dhammadesanaṃ / vaṇṇayaṃ tassa vīrassa sāvakassa mahāguṇaṃ: // //
tha-ap533:8.1: Saṅkhittena mayā vuttaṃ vitthārena pakāsayaṃ / parisaṃ mañ ca toseti yathā Kaccāyano ayaṃ. // //
tha-ap533:9.1: Nāhaṃ evaṃ vidhaṃ kañci aññaṃ passāmi sāvakaṃ / tasmā 'tadagge es' aggo evaṃ dhāretha bhikkhavo. // //
tha-ap533:10.1: Tadāhaṃ vimhito hutvā sutvā vākyamanoramaṃ / Himavantaṃ gamitvāna āhatvā pupphasañcayaṃ // //
tha-ap533:11.1: Pūjetvā lokasaraṇaṃ tan ṭhānaṃ abhipatthayiṃ. / tadā mam' āsayaṃ ñatvā vyāhāsi saraṇañjaho: // //
tha-ap533:12.1: Passath' etaṃ isivaraṃ niddhantakanakattacaṃ / uddhaggalomaṃ pīn' aṃsaṃ acalaṃ añjaliṃ ṭhitaṃ. // //
tha-ap533:14.1: Kaccānassa guṇaṃ sutvā taṃ ṭhānaṃ patthayaṃ ṭhito / anāgatamhi addhāne Gotamassa mahāmune. // //
tha-ap533:15.1: Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito / Kaccāno nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako. // //
tha-ap533:16.1: Bahussuto mahāñāṇī adhippāyavidū mune / pāpuṇissati taṃ ṭhānaṃ yathāyaṃ vyākato mayā. // //
tha-ap533:17.1: Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap533:18.1: Duve bhave saṃsarāmi devatte atha mānuse / aññagatiṃ na gacchāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap533:19.1: Duve kule pajāyāmi khattiye atha brāhmaṇe / nīce kule na jāyāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap533:20.1: Pacchime ca bhave dāni jāto Ujjeniye pure / Pajjotassa Acaṇḍassa purohitadijātino. // //
tha-ap533:21.1: Putto Tirīṭivacchassa nipuṇo vedapāragū / mātā ca Candapadumā Kaccāno haṃ varattaco. // //
tha-ap533:22.1: Vīmaṃsanatthaṃ Buddhassa bhūmipālena pesito / disvā mokkhapuradvāraṃ nāyakaṃ guṇasañcayaṃ // //
tha-ap533:23.1: Sutvā ca vimalaṃ vākyaṃ gatipaṅkavisosanaṃ / pāpuṇiṃ amataṃ santaṃ satehi saha pañcahi. // //
tha-ap533:24.1: Adhippāyavidū jāto sugatassa mahāmate / ṭhapito etadagge ca susamiddhamanoratho.
tha-ap533:28.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Mahākaccāno thero i. g. a-ti.
